items.criterion: The booking file names five phases and a contract, and the option that produced it reads confirmed.
items.judgment: Place a ranked option on a space set and a window, then convert it into a booking that creates the space set, the five phases and the contract together.

items.criterion: A hall inside a held combination answers blocked_by_ancestor naming the combination, and the combination answers blocked_by_descendant when a member is held.
items.judgment: Resolve a hold against every ancestor and every descendant of the node it names, and say which space is blocking.

items.criterion: The smaller hall licenses the larger figure, and the combination licenses less than its two halls would sum to.
items.judgment: Read capacity from a stored licence row rather than computing it, and give a combination its own row.

items.criterion: Exactly one booking row exists for the contended window afterwards, and the loser is refused with the space and window named.
items.judgment: Enforce the no-overlap rule in the store, so two confirmations arriving together cannot both succeed.

items.criterion: The hall is not free during build-up, and a turnaround that does not fit is refused with the shortfall in hours.
items.judgment: Write build-up, run, tear-down, access and clearance as occupancy rows rather than as annotations, and measure a turnaround against them.

items.criterion: A stand across a fire exit is refused with the rule named and the clearance measured.
items.judgment: Check a placement against the fire exits, aisles, columns and rigging limits of the real geometry at the moment of placement.

items.criterion: A planner submitting a revision cannot approve it, and cannot publish another party's event.
items.judgment: Refuse an approval decision from the same account that submitted the revision, at the server.

items.criterion: The contractor whose insurance has expired reads expired, and a scan of that badge is refused for expired_evidence.
items.judgment: Derive accreditation state from the evidence expiry at read time so a lapsed certificate withdraws its badge the moment it lapses.

items.criterion: The exhibitor accredited by the revoked organiser reads revoked within a second, and the count of cascaded rows is reported.
items.judgment: Withdraw every accreditation granted beneath the one revoked, and every badge derived from those, as part of the revocation.

items.criterion: One entrance reads contractor for build-up while its neighbour keeps its own mode, and the scan log holds both decisions.
items.judgment: Store a mode per entrance per booking per phase and append every scan with its decision and its reason.

items.criterion: The combination and its member halls agree, and each compares against its own licensed figure.
items.judgment: Derive a space occupancy from the scans across the graph so a person inside a combination is present in every member hall exactly once.

items.criterion: A scan during evacuation is refused, the declaration is timestamped, and standing down restores admission.
items.judgment: Suspend admission campus-wide on declaration, open every entrance as an exit and freeze the log.

items.criterion: A power drop with no position on the plan is refused naming the dependency, and an accepted order is stored against its booking.
items.judgment: Check a service order against its approved-plan and plan-position requirements before accepting it.

items.criterion: The lines sum exactly to the total, and a repeated export returns the first external reference.
items.judgment: Compute tax per line, record the rounding decision on the line, and make an export idempotent on its key.

items.criterion: The privately held booking appears on no public surface, and no public row carries a rate, a contact or an occupancy figure.
items.judgment: Store the public field subset apart from the operations record so an internal field has no path to a public response.

items.criterion: The exhibitor reads its own stand and orders, and a forged request for another stand does not disclose that the stand exists.
items.judgment: Resolve the caller to a stand and answer a request for any other stand as not found.

items.criterion: Operations cannot confirm, a coordinator cannot declare evacuation, finance cannot issue a badge and the auditor reads nothing but the trail.
items.judgment: Check the caller's role at the endpoint rather than relying on the interface to hide the control.

items.criterion: No response tells an unauthenticated caller whether an address has an account, and a signed-out token fails on the next request.
items.judgment: Answer an unknown address and a wrong password identically, refuse every console route to a caller with no session, and stop a signed-out token at once.

items.criterion: Neither the auditor nor a coordinator can remove a row, and every row names its actor, action, target and time.
items.judgment: Refuse an update or a delete against the audit table in the store rather than by omitting the control.

items.criterion: The second rank-one option is refused, and a filter matching nothing returns no rows rather than an error.
items.judgment: Refuse a second option claiming a rank already held on the same space and window, and answer an impossible filter with an empty list.

items.criterion: The three home routes each declare their own language, and the pinned hero line, skip link, copyright, status chips and parking figure are all present.
items.judgment: Render each route in its own language with its own document language declaration and the pinned copy in place.

items.criterion: The submitted enquiry appears on the enquiry desk, a repeated address answers already, and a page view with no consent is refused.
items.judgment: Create an enquiry row from a public submission, refuse a second subscription for one address, and record no page view without statistics consent.

items.criterion: Report rows name only spaces the campus has, the booking records its version, and the public and console paths agree.
items.judgment: Compute reports from the ledgers, record the licence version each booking was written under, and answer availability from one authority everywhere.
